state.seed_assertion: An output transistor should not be replaced without first verifying the load coil resistance, as a shorted coil will destroy the replacement card.

sentences.1: An output transistor should not be replaced without first verifying the load coil resistance, as a shorted coil will destroy the replacement card.
sentences.2: Replacing a dead output transistor without checking the load coil resistance first.
sentences.3: A shorted coil will kill the replacement card just as fast.
sentences.4: A coil resistance reading close to zero indicates a shorted coil that may have already destroyed the output transistor.
sentences.5: A reading close to zero means a shorted coil that may have already killed the output transistor.
sentences.6: When an output bit is ON in software but the field device does not operate, possible causes include a broken wire, an open coil, or a missing return path in the load circuit.
sentences.7: Extremely low resistance in a coil may indicate the coil is shorted.
sentences.8: If you read full supply voltage but the device does not run, the fault is in the load circuit: broken wire, open coil, or a missing return path.
sentences.9: Axial loading on encoder bearings can cause intermittent faults that progressively worsen until a hard fault occurs, as bearing breakdown impacts electronics integrity.
sentences.10: Forcing PLC inputs and outputs should only be used carefully in test mode after ensuring safe conditions and must be immediately removed after testing.
sentences.11: A quality multimeter is the most essential tool for PLC troubleshooting to measure voltages, verify continuity, and check signal current.
sentences.12: Measure voltages at terminals, verify continuity, and check signal current.
